tasks.prompt:
The signed-in shell of Lumen. Three screens share one layout: a dashboard at `/` (a welcome line and a few summary cards), a projects list at `/projects`, and a settings page at `/settings`. On desktop a left sidebar holds the navigation and can be collapsed to icons. The navigation has nested groups: an "Analytics" group containing "Overview" and "Reports", and a "Workspace" group containing "Projects" and "Settings". The current route is highlighted in the navigation. A header shows a breadcrumb for the current screen. On phones the sidebar is replaced by a menu button that opens the navigation in a drawer.

Brand: build it in Lumen's visual identity below. Carry it through the design system's own theming (its theme tokens, config or provider), not one-off styles on each element, so every screen follows it.
- Personality: calm, exact and trustworthy, like a well-kept ledger.
- Brand colour #0F766E: primary buttons, the current navigation item, links and focus rings.
- Neutrals: cool slate grey.
- Corner radius: 2px on buttons, inputs, cards and menus.
- Headings in Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; body text in ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif.
- Default theme: light.
- Density: compact: tight rows and small controls, information-dense.
